changelog: - **A table's Refresh keeps your choices when you go Back and Next.** In Data ▸ Refresh or manage imported tables… ▸ Refresh…, going Back and then Next cleared what you had chosen even when nothing had changed: on Column changes, a renamed column's match and a new column's role, with Map more columns closed again; on Review, Add this row and a missing row's Keep as-is or Delete. The wizard now keeps the Column changes choices while the incoming header row is the same, and the Review choices while the pasted rows, the header row, Ignore last N rows and the column choices are the same. A change to any of these still resets them, and Commit refresh applies the choices shown.
